how_pct_was_used: The Propensity to Cycle Tool (PCT) is used to analyze local trip patterns based on Census Journey to Work and school travel data, and to build a picture of relative cycle flows in different parts of the network to inform demand-based planning.
other_tools_developed: Cycling Level of Service (CLoS) tool, Junction Assessment Tool (JAT), and Route Selection Tool (RST)
specific_evidence_of_impact: The tool is used to allocate trips to the transport network to build a picture of relative cycle flows, helping to identify gaps in the cycle network and prioritize infrastructure interventions.
